form.descricao_placeholder: Describe the facts in detail (at least 20 characters)...
form.localizacao_placeholder: Street, number, district, city — or pick the point on the map
form.coordenada_ajuda: click the map or drag the marker
form.localizacao_dica: You can also set the incident location on the map.
form.endereco_nao_localizado: Address not found. Adjust the text or pick the point on the map.
form.endereco_localizado: Address located — coordinate filled in. Check the marker if you want to adjust.
form.mapa_instrucao: Click the point where the incident happened: the address and the latitude/longitude are filled in with the same click. Drag the marker to adjust.
form.endereco_do_mapa: Address taken from the map (you can edit it)
form.buscando_endereco: Looking up the address of the marked point...
form.coordenada_pendente: Incident coordinate not set yet — use "Locate address" or pick the point on the map.

evidencias.ajuda: PDF, JPG, JPEG or PNG; up to 10 MB per file and 10 files per occurrence.
evidencias.formato_invalido: Select only PDF, JPG, JPEG or PNG files
evidencias.tamanho_excedido: Each evidence file must be at most 10 MB
evidencias.erro_upload: The occurrence was registered, but one evidence file could not be uploaded.

erros.campos_obrigatorios: Fill in the nature and the address/location
erros.descricao_curta: Description must have at least 20 characters
erros.sem_coordenada: Set the incident coordinate: locate the address or pick the point on the map
erros.data_futura: Date/time cannot be in the future
erros.sem_envolvidos: Add at least one involved person

registro.aguardando: the occurrence is in the Chief's review queue.

detalhe.excluida: Occurrence deleted (logical deletion — record kept for audit)

minhas.selecione: Select an occurrence to see details.

fila.selecione: Select an occurrence from the queue.

revisao.justificativa_label: Justification (required to return or reject, at least 10 characters)
revisao.justificativa_curta: Provide a justification with at least 10 characters
revisao.ok_validar: Occurrence validated — available on the tactical panel.

admin.aviso: Archiving or deleting requires your authorization as Chief and a reason (at least 10 characters). The act is audited with your user, timestamp and reason.
admin.motivo_curto: Provide a reason with at least 10 characters
admin.confirmar_arquivar: Archive occurrence {{protocolo}}? It leaves the review/dispatch flow but remains available for consultation.
admin.confirmar_excluir: Delete occurrence {{protocolo}}? Deletion is logical and final: it disappears from listings, but the record is kept for audit. This cannot be undone.
admin.bloqueado_atendimento: An occurrence in progress cannot be archived or deleted.

apreensoes.ajuda_registro: Record seized weapons, drugs, vehicles, cash or objects directly in the report. Each item gets a unique seal and is permanently linked to this occurrence (chain of custody — RF03).
apreensoes.ajuda_aba: Each item has a unique seal, a permanent link to the occurrence and an append-only chain of custody (who, when, from where, to where).
apreensoes.ajuda: Seal and storage/safe location are required. Serial number only if legible.
apreensoes.ajuda_arma: Firearms require brand and caliber; enter the serial number if legible.
apreensoes.vazio: No seized items in this occurrence.
apreensoes.status_bloqueado: The occurrence in this status does not accept new seizures.
apreensoes.ok_registrado: Item {{lacre}} recorded with a unique seal.
apreensoes.erro_registrar: Could not record the seized item.
apreensoes.erro_auto: Could not issue the Seizure Report.
apreensoes.erro_quantidade_invalida: Quantity must be an integer greater than zero
apreensoes.erro_lacre_duplicado: This seal is already in use — seals are unique per item

auto.integridade: SHA-256 hash of the content (items + chain of custody). The issuance was recorded in the audit trail.
